definitions.gloss: running into someone; bumping into; unexpected encounter
definitions.explanation: An unplanned meeting with someone, often in an awkward or unwelcome situation. Literally refers to two heads bumping together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{元|もと}カノ→元カノ：29939_motokano⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{鉢合|はちあ}わせ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I ran into my ex-girlfriend at the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{鉢合|はちあ}わせ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{気|き}まずかった→気まずい：06536_kimazui⟧。
examples.english: I bumped into my boss in the hallway and it was awkward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{泥棒|どろぼう}→泥棒：01688_dorobou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{逃|に}げよう→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧とした⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧、⟦{帰宅|きたく}した→帰宅する：22169_kitakusuru⟧⟦{住人|じゅうにん}→住人：11611_juunin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{鉢合|はちあ}わせ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: The burglar tried to escape but ran right into the returning resident.

notes:
An unexpected, often unwelcome encounter. The word comes from the image of two people bumping heads (⟦{鉢|はち}→鉢：29581_hachi⟧ refers to the top of the head).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉢合|はちあ}わせ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to run into someone)
- {鉢合|はちあ}わせ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to end up running into each other)
- ⟦{偶然|ぐうぜん}→偶然：02674_guuzen⟧{鉢合|はちあ}わせ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to accidentally run into)

Often implies the encounter is inconvenient, embarrassing, or unwanted. Used more dramatically than ⟦{出|で}くわす→出くわす：04631_dekuwasu⟧ (to come across) or ⟦{偶然|ぐうぜん}→偶然：02674_guuzen⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧ (to meet by chance).
